photo.alt: Low islands seen from the International Space Station

facts: Three islands: Grand Cayman, Cayman Brac and Little Cayman
worth_knowing: The islands lie south of Cuba and north-east of Honduras, between Jamaica and Mexico's Yucatán Peninsula. Grand Cayman is the largest and the most populous.
